question_set.question: Use highlight_region_by_value in order to know What patterns can be observed in blood pressure across different pregnancy counts and diabetes outcomes?

answer.value: The highest average blood pressure (82.06) is observed in women with 9 pregnancies and diabetes. Generally, diabetic women tend to have higher blood pressure than non-diabetic women, especially at higher pregnancy counts. Blood pressure shows an increasing trend with more pregnancies for both diabetic and non-diabetic women

key_insights: Highest blood pressure occurs in women with 9 pregnancies and diabetes
Diabetic women tend to have higher blood pressure than non-diabetic women
Blood pressure increases with more pregnancies
Non-diabetic women with 11 pregnancies also show high blood pressure

reasoning_trace.rationale: Use highlight_region_by_value to identify patterns in blood pressure across pregnancy counts and diabetes outcomes
